metadata.description: Plain-language web automation inside your own logged-in browser.

plugins.name: basivo-operator
plugins.description: Do plain-language tasks on any website inside your own logged-in browser. No APIs, no cookies, no stored credentials. Draft-first, human-in-the-loop before anything irreversible. Ships Medium/LinkedIn/Substack/Dev.to/Hashnode playbooks + a generic discovery engine.
